challenges.says: Criteria 2 and 3 (domain folder selectable only when joined and the folder exists) and criterion 9 (missing typed folder refused with the exact message, dialog stays open) restate sentences of businessrule-76226373219464614800 and businessrule-53176229115945924012 but cite nothing, so their source is lost.

Criterion 4 ("no domain can be reached ... shown as a normal case and the other choices still work") cites integrations.decision-7, a decision about how the API resolves accounts; no rule or decision states that the screen shows this, so it invents behaviour, and "shown as a normal case" is not wording a product owner can test.

Criterion 7 (Browse picks a folder and it appears in the folder box) cites integrations.decision-1, which only says the local API reads folders instead of browser pickers and says nothing of a Browse dialog; the behaviour comes from an action with no rule, so the criterion should say it has no cited rule or cite the action's rule, not a decision that cannot carry it.
The "what" says the person is told "at once" if the folder does not exist, but the rule only refuses the folder when OK is pressed; nothing states an immediate check.

Criterion 1 (nothing loaded, so the person is not asked whether to replace, and the folder loads) cites businessrule-43765682097437166867, which only says the clear-workspace option is ticked by default and passed on when a folder was accepted; the not-asking behaviour comes from the journey step, not that rule, so the citation overstates it.

Criteria 2, 3, 5, 6, 8 and 11 (replace proposed by default and add possible, no choice passed on when nothing accepted, adding joins the loaded set, problems reported and load carries on, workspace shows what was loaded and view rebuilt, remembered folder unchanged when adding) are sentences of businessrule-43765682097437166867, businessrule-06850078746756456273, businessrule-19671296259932138006 and businessrule-56221298079625729644 but cite nothing.

Criterion 10 (replace chosen, no failure, so the folder is loaded again at the next start) cites integrations.decision-4, which only moves remembered choices to the Preference store, instead of businessrule-56221298079625729644 that states the remembering rule; the decision cannot carry it, and the rule says the folder is remembered, not that it is loaded at start.
